description: Search the BotShelf Vampire shelf by words (up to 16 different words). Use it when you know the job but not the item, for example "code review" or "meeting notes". Every word must match the title, description, type, where-it-runs, topic, keywords or id; items in which every word stands at the start of a word ("test" in "tests", not in "contest") come first. Returns short cards (id, title, summary, kind, where it runs, access) and the total number of matches. Next: call get_item with a card's id for the full text. When no item matches every word, the reply carries a hint and, if some items match part of the words, suggestions: the items that match most of them. When a filter value is not in use, filter_note says so. Filters: kind, runs_on, topic, access, checked; list_filters returns the values they accept.

access.description: open = full text readable without sign-up. paid = listed, text not available here.

checked.description: true = only items with a recorded check.

kind.description: Kind of item, for example team, build, toolkit, grokbot, trade, guide, field. list_filters returns the kinds that exist.

query.description: Words to look for, for example "code review" or "meeting notes".

runs_on.description: Where it runs, exactly as shown on the shelf, for example "Claude Code", "Grok Bot", "Ollama", "TradingView". list_filters returns the names in use.

topic.description: Topic label exactly as shown on the shelf, for example "Research". list_filters returns the topics in use.

name: search_items

filter_note.description: Present when a filter value is not in use on the shelf.

hint.description: Present when nothing matched: what to try next.

items.description: The best matches, at most limit of them.

access.description: open = full text readable without sign-up. paid = listed, text not available here.

check_recorded.description: true when a check of the item is on record.

id.description: Item id: the site path. Pass it to get_item.

kind.description: Kind of item, one of the kinds list_filters returns.

runs_on.description: Where it runs, as shown on the shelf.

text_url.description: Address of the item's plain text file; null when it has none that is open.

type.description: The label of the item's type as shown on the shelf.

suggestions.description: Present when no item matches every word of a query of two or more words, but some items match part of them: the items that match most of the words.
